instructions:
1. Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
2. Keep your arms extended down by your sides, upper arms and elbows pressed against the wall.
3. Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
4. Squeeze at the top for a moment.
5. Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms and elbows against the wall to isolate the arms.
2. Move slowly and avoid using momentum.
3. Keep the neutral grip fixed through the full range.
4. Brace your core and keep your back flat against the wall.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, dumbbells hanging at thigh level.
2. Hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbells toward your knees with a flat back.
3. Explosively extend your hips and knees and shrug your shoulders to pull the dumbbells up.
4. Drop into a partial squat and rotate your elbows under to catch the dumbbells on your shoulders.
5. Stand tall by extending your hips and knees.
6. Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the lift with your hips and legs, not your lower back.
2. Move explosively on the pull and catch with control.
3. Keep the dumbbells close to your body during the pull.
4. Keep your chest up and back flat throughout.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Raise both arms out to the sides at shoulder height, elbows high, palms facing up.
3. Curl the dumbbells inward toward your head by bending your elbows.
4. Squeeze at the top for a moment.
5. Extend your arms back out to shoulder height under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms fixed at shoulder height throughout.
2. Use a controlled motion and avoid swinging.
3. Focus on contracting the biceps at the top.
4. Keep your shoulders steady and avoid shrugging.

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell across your hips with both hands.
3. Press through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
5. Lower your hips back to the starting position under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Press through your heels to maximize glute activation.
2. Keep a neutral spine and avoid arching your lower back.
3. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
4. Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down at lockout.

instructions:
1. Sit on an incline bench set near 45 degrees, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging down and palms facing forward.
2. Curl the right dumbbell up toward your shoulder by bending your elbow.
3. Squeeze at the top for a moment.
4. Lower the right dumbbell under control while starting to curl the left dumbbell.
5. Continue alternating arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms stationary to isolate the biceps.
2. Let the arms stretch fully at the bottom for a longer range.
3. Move under control and avoid swinging.
4. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
